_note: The ID header sits over the second column. RISK-1's ID cell holds an ESC (a terminal colour escape) and a lone CR, and a Result with no Threshold, so its id is printed in a finding. RISK-2's Result names no experience reason and holds every bidi embedding, override and isolate (U+202A-U+202E, U+2066-U+2069) and both separators (U+2028, U+2029), so the finding quotes them. PC1 fails the case when any of those characters reaches K1's output raw: this pins each range of the escaper.
